title: sharing/calendars MemoryBackend silently ignore filter/sort
description: Found auditing JMAP-yt1w.25. crate-jmap-sharing-server/src/memory.rs query_objects ignores filter AND sort (documented, returns all ids); crate-jmap-calendars-server/src/memory.rs query_objects ignores sort (bd:JMAP-ic0j.16). RFC 8620 §5.5: a server MUST reject with unsupportedFilter/unsupportedSort if it cannot process them. Reference impls should return BackendQueryError::Method(JmapError::unsupported_filter()/unsupported_sort()) like jmap-tasks-server. Filenode sort is JMAP-yt1w.27.
close_reason: Batch 21 (run wf_18048230-8ff): implemented, adversarially verified; CI green except new cargo-deny advisory RUSTSEC-2026-0387 (crypto-bigint 0.5.5, unrelated to these changes) at 741292f0; beqc spec commits 639dc1d/7787c51 in jmap-chat-spec (not pushed)
